lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Hello. Welcome to our restaurant. How many people are in your party?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Of course. Would you like something to drink?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, please. I'd like orange juice.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: What would you like to eat today?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Could I have grilled chicken, please?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Certainly. Would you like a dessert?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, please. Chocolate cake sounds great.
